command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
uname -r
command -v openssl
command -v update-ca-certificates
systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true
find /usr/local/share/ca-certificates -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort

set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
uname -r
command -v openssl
command -v update-ca-certificates
systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true
find /usr/local/share/ca-certificates -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort

set -eu
id -u
for p in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then printf 'exists %s\n' "$p"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"; fi
done

set -eu
id -u
for p in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then printf 'exists %s\n' "$p"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"; fi
done

set -eu
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 \
  -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 0600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates

set -eu
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -nodes -days 3650 \
  -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt \
  -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' \
  -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0' \
  -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
  -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' \
  -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 0600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'os_release='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
stat -c 'key_mode=%a key_owner=%U:%G' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
stat -c 'cert_mode=%a cert_owner=%U:%G' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+2p; /X509v3 Key Usage/,+1p'
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
cert_hash=$(openssl x509 -hash -noout -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt)
ls -l "/etc/ssl/certs/${cert_hash}.0"
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
printf 'key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
